pages.text: $(thing)Cigarette:$() craft exactly 1 loose tobacco with 1 Rolling Paper anywhere in the crafting grid. No other ingredients may be present. The result carries the tobacco's processing metadata and a product-quality score based on tobacco quality and cut.
For cigarettes, $(thing)Shag$() is the ideal cut. Ribbon is a good second choice. Rough and Flake are heavily penalized and cap the final cigarette quality at 6/10 and 5/10 respectively.
pages.title: Cigarette Cut

pages.text: $(thing)Cigar:$() craft exactly 1 loose tobacco with 1 Tobacco Leaf. The loose tobacco is the filler and determines the filler product score; the leaf is recorded as the wrapper. The cigar preserves aging/fermentation information from its ingredients.
pages.title: Cigar Recipe

pages.text: For cigars, $(thing)Flake$() is ideal. Rough is the strong second choice. Ribbon caps at 7/10 and Shag at 4/10. A cigar lasts $(item)100 puffs$(); a cigarette lasts $(item)15 puffs$().
pages.title: Cigar Cut & Puffs
